snippet.title: Forage Wizard Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3868320/Forage_Wizard/

Become the Forage Wizard in this casual incremental game. Progress through a branching skill tree and uncover the secrets of the glade. Collect items and refine them into powerful magical resources. Use these to build your own productive and customizable base. You can farm crops, slay monsters and automate your alchemical production.
